basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed AI Engineer | Staff-Level Production Systems | Agentic SDLC & Governance | Enterprise Customer Focus
basics.summary: Forward Deployed Engineer by practice, not just by title. Runs Anand Creations as an independent Forward Deployed Engineering practice; embeds with teams to diagnose adoption blockers, contribute production code, and turn field learning into durable patterns. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps driving governed, measurable adoption of a production agentic system (2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly) with evals, tracing, context management, and human-in-the-loop guardrails. 13+ years shipping enterprise-grade systems for Fortune-500 customers ($1.5M+ revenue at Beekeeper, Unilever partnership at Dronistics). 4 international conference talks and published writing on production agentic AI, memory, and reliability, the shape of thought leadership this role expects.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Drive governed, measurable adoption of a production agentic system across the org. Multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP, and AG-UI. Human-in-the-loop guardrails and verification loops for AI safety. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware store. Context management and grounding that keeps agents auditable and stops hallucination.

Own the reliability layer: eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, fallback paths, and on-call. Report to C-level on outcomes; cross-functional coordination with Sales, Product, and Ops without formal authority.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end for enterprise customers. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Direct engagement with strategic accounts, from discovery through post-launch stewardship.

Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions CI/CD + OpenAI). Turned a field blocker into a durable product capability, then transitioned ownership to the product team.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams (indexing, ranking, distributed templating engine that powers 15% of assets for 10M+ users). Cross-functional coordination without formal authority.
Ran observability and global on-call (K8s, AWS, Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; engineers now lead features independently.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups for seed-to-VC decisions on architecture, scalability, and AI adoption. Cross-functional coordination without authority is the entire job.
Advised portfolio companies on production AI adoption: prompt design, evals, governance, and safe rollout patterns for enterprise workflows.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery startup. Shipped full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra) from empty repo to 500+ deliveries.
Direct engagement with strategic enterprise customers (Unilever) and a CES Las Vegas showcase. Turned field feedback into product roadmap.

projects.description: Independent Forward Deployed Engineering practice. Embed with teams, run technical discovery, resolve adoption blockers, and ship production agentic AI end to end without becoming a permanent dependency. Home for the AI products I build and ship myself (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView), each a real reference for the patterns I bring to client engagements.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data. Explainability by design: if the model cannot justify the signal, it does not ship. Live users on real-time feeds; AI-safety principles baked in.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Compliance
projects.description: AI-native compliance platform for cross-border finances. RAG-grounded assistant answers regulatory questions with citations back to the source; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Staff FDE for GitLab's Duo Agent Platform. Field-situated product engineer: diagnose strategic customer adoption blockers, contribute production code, drive governed AI adoption (agentic SDLC), and produce thought-leadership artefacts. Cross-functional coordination without authority. Rails/Go preferred; agentic AI + adoption experience essential.
_jobApplication.notes: Reframed hard around Forward Deployed Engineering (Anand Creations literally is one). Emphasized LumApps agentic system as governed enterprise AI adoption (matches Duo Agent Platform shape), Beekeeper enterprise customer engagement + tech lead across teams, Tenity cross-functional advisory, Dronistics enterprise partnership. Publications reframed as reference frameworks / adoption artefacts (thought-leadership signal). GAP: no Rails/Go — using Python/Java/Vue/TypeScript. If they gate strictly on language, this filters; if they weigh agentic + FDE experience heavier (JD language suggests they do), strong fit.
